name: Shachi Ikari
source:
Ikari loves to swim, and her life goal is to swim faster than anyone ever has before. She greatly respects [url=/c98601]Hibiki[/url], who is the only one that beats her in that category. She also thinks that [url=/c98597]Ushio[/url] smells good, and has a bad habit of biting people when she sees them.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
